geez.description: Ge'ez verse or range in this chapter, e.g. "3" or "3-4"

greek.description: Greek verse or range in this chapter, e.g. "2" or "2-3"; empty string if the Ge'ez has no Greek counterpart

confidence.description: 0.9 plainly the same; 0.7-0.85 a division differs or the line joins a passage; 0.5 unsure

note.description: Short reason when confidence is below 0.9 or greek is empty; else empty
